sources.name: Project Gutenberg
sources.changes:
Categories: Fiction, Poetry, Drama, Science fiction, Adventure, Romance, Mystery, Horror, Fairy tales, Children,
History, Philosophy. Each is a subject search of the OPDS feed (s.<subject>), combined with the reader's search
(query={{search}} {{category}}). Requires an app version that reads categories.

sources.name: Standard Ebooks
sources.changes:
- Standard Ebooks from standardebooks.org directly: catalog from the /ebooks HTML pages (12 per page,
  server-side ?query= search), metadata and description from each book page, "Compatible epub" link as
  the document (served directly, no redirect). Rights: public domain (CC0 editions of public-domain texts).

sources.name: xkcd
sources.changes:
- xkcd from xkcd.com directly: catalog from /archive/ (~3,300 comics), title and single image per
  comic from /<n>/, hover text as the description. Rights: CC BY-NC 2.5.
